Container.Name: sitshow
Container.Overview: Sit Show - Musical Chairs Royale. A multiplayer browser game show: avatars circle the chairs while the music plays, and when it stops each chair goes to whoever solves its mini-puzzle first. Put MP3s in the music folder for the host's song picker.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port players open in their browser.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Saved player levels (profiles.json). Also holds the music folder unless you map one below.

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Folder of MP3s for the host's song picker. Can point at an existing share.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the game runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the game runs as (100 = users).
